newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks rebound to end slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks rebound to end slightly up.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished slightly higher on Monday amid short-covering after the 100-share index slipped in early trade, dealers said.
They said selective buying by institutions in some leading blue chips prompted speculators to cover their short positions.
The Karachi index rose 1.54 points, or 0.10 percent, to close at 1,524.14. The index had dropped to 1,513.29 in early trade. Losers led gainers 161 to 43.
Hub Power Co rose 0.30 rupees to 36.10 rupees and Pakistan State Oil 6.0 to 281.
